sources.entry: claude-obsidian by Agrici Daniel - Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Claude reads any source, links it, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin and set of Agent Skills that turns sources you drop into an Obsidian vault into linked, cited Markdown notes forming a connected knowledge graph, based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
summary.what_it_does: Sources placed in an inbox folder are kept as untouched, content-named copies, and Claude writes linked wiki pages, indexes and maps of content that cite those sources. Users can ask questions answered from the vault with citations (read-only), save chosen answers as notes, and run a health check for dead links, orphan pages, missing metadata and empty sections. Writes are planned first, fingerprinted with SHA-256 to detect conflicting edits, applied as a single transaction, and recoverable from a journal if interrupted. The README describes 15 skills (wiki setup, ingest, query, save, lint, research, Canvas, filing modes such as Generic, LYT, PARA and Zettelkasten, local BM25 search, and Obsidian Markdown/Bases references) plus three read-only agents. A Python command line (scripts/claude-obsidian.py) exposes the same core, and a setup script can link the skills into Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, ZCode, Cursor and Windsurf.
use_cases: Build a linked personal knowledge base from papers and articles
Ask questions answered from my own notes with citations
Keep research notes that point back to their original sources
Health-check an Obsidian vault for broken links and orphan notes
Adopt an existing Obsidian vault with an AI assistant without moving notes
Organize notes using PARA, Zettelkasten or Maps of Content conventions
how_to_run: claude (start Claude Code in your vault folder)
/claude-obsidian:wiki (set up the vault; shows a preview first)
notable: Sources are kept as untouched content-addressed copies so every summary can trace back to its origin
Writes are fingerprinted with SHA-256 and applied as one transaction; edits made in Obsidian mid-plan cause a conflict instead of an overwrite
Read-only agents and a single transaction core are the only write path
Four filing modes (Generic, LYT, PARA, Zettelkasten) that change where new notes go without moving old ones
Same skills can be linked into Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, ZCode, Cursor and Windsurf via a setup script
caveats: Windows writes require WSL; native Windows can only inspect and preview
PDFs and EPUBs get no built-in text extraction; web pages and YouTube need a separate runner, and OCR needs an external tool
Backups are still recommended, especially with sync of Canvas or Base files, since the lock only coordinates local cooperating writers
